Macro Governance Synthesis & Policy Dynamics

Across Nigeria’s 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory, reported executive activity during the week focused on fiscal planning, energy development, public-service delivery and social protection. Katsina’s early approval of its 2027 budget and solar investments, Lagos’s work on electricity and urban infrastructure, and several states’ commitments to healthcare and education illustrate the range of priorities competing for public resources.

Editorial note: PSI and SIS rankings are reproduced from the reporting dataset for comparative use. Financial figures, projected savings, project status and reported outcomes should be interpreted according to their stated status and verified against the relevant official records.

Governor Dikko Umaru Radda • Katsina State (NORTH WEST)

Key developments and governance significance: Governor Dikko Umaru Radda signed the ₦828.58 billion 2027 Appropriation Law, approved 20 MW Solar PV systems across 11 critical public facilities to save ₦7 billion.
